name: Ōji (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ōji town emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by horizontal bars enclosing the character 王.
history: Municipal flag of Ōji, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 September 1957.

features.role: Ōji town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by horizontal bars enclosing the character 王
